ai.recapInstruction: Write a session recap for {date} in first person ("I"), 120-200 words, markdown with a short "**Keep**" and "**Fix**" list at the end.

ask.title: Ask your journal
ask.hint: Uses the selected accounts and journal filters. Changing filters clears the answer.
ask.placeholder: Why do my Monday shorts keep failing?
ask.suggestionWeekday: Which weekday should I stop trading?
ask.suggestionDirection: Am I better at longs or shorts?

noMatchingTrades.title: No matching trades
noMatchingTrades.description: There are no trades to analyze in this selection. Adjust the accounts, dates or other journal filters.

checkFilters.title: Check your journal filters
checkFilters.description: The selected scope is no longer valid. Update the accounts and filters before trying again.

refreshJournal.title: Refresh your journal
refreshJournal.description: The journal timezone changed. Refresh this page so the displayed dates and AI analysis agree.

setUpAi.title: Set up AI to continue
setUpAi.description: Connect an Anthropic or OpenAI API key in Settings to ask questions, generate recaps, and review trades.

checkConnection.title: Check your AI connection
checkConnection.description: Your AI provider couldn’t verify your key or permissions. Review them in Settings, then try again.

billing.title: Your AI account needs attention
billing.description: Check the billing, credit balance, or quota on your AI provider account, then try again.

checkModel.title: Check your AI model
checkModel.description: Check the model ID and your provider account’s access in Settings.

rateLimit.title: AI is temporarily busy
rateLimit.description: Please wait a moment before trying again. Your journal data hasn’t changed.

emptyJournal.title: Add trades to get started
emptyJournal.description: AI insights use your journal history. Import your trades, then ask your question again.

noRecap.title: No trades to recap yet
noRecap.description: A recap needs at least one closed trade on this day. You can still write your own day note.

signIn.title: Please sign in again
signIn.description: Your session may have expired. Sign in to continue using your journal.

connection.title: Couldn’t connect to AI
connection.description: Check your connection and try again. Your journal data hasn’t changed.

fallback.title: Couldn’t complete the AI request
fallback.description: Please try again in a moment. If this continues, check your AI settings.
